sources.title: litert-community/gemma-4-E4B-it-litert-lm - Models
sources.snippet: This particular Gemma 4 model is small so it is ideal for on-device use cases. By running this model on device, users can have private access to Generative AI technology without even requiring an internet connection. These models are provided in the .litertlm format for use with the LiteRT-LM framework.

sources.title: gemma-4-E4B-it-litert-lm: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: A: The E4B model is text-only. Vision and audio models are mentioned as loading on-demand but are not documented. The newer gemma-3n-E4B-it-litert-lm supports multimodal input; migrate to that if you need image or audio understanding.
